operations.details: Verified GOV.UK HMLR INSPIRE Index Polygons guidance.
Legacy guidance separated from current Use land and property data publication service.
GML delivery treated as data format, not precision upgrade.
INSPIRE indicative location rejected as exact individual-title extent.
Verified GOV.UK National Polygon Service guidance.
National Polygon, title-UPRN and Title Descriptor products kept semantically separate.
No licensed or chargeable NPS records acquired or required.
Title Descriptor legal attributes rejected as survey or terrain values.
No HMLR indexing product promoted to exact determined-boundary precision.
No registration metadata converted into inferred elevation.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
